voice.description: The voice that speaks the narration. Run "Coding Tutor: Sample voices" to hear them all.

defaultDepth.description: How much the narration says when you have not asked for a particular depth.
enumDescriptions: One or two sentences on what was done and where.
Each function or file named, with what it is for and why it exists.
Inside each function: its main components, without reading lines.
Every line, including alternatives that were rejected.

muted.description: Captions only, no voice. The coder is still paced at reading speed.

narratorModel.description: The model the narrator runs on, passed to your agent as is: for Claude Code its --model (sonnet, opus, ...), for OpenCode its provider/model (as `opencode models` lists it). One model for every agent, or one per agent. Empty, or an agent left out: that agent's default model, the one you code with.

oneOf.description: The same model for every agent.
